description: Upcoming and live auction sales that include Hermès lots (Birkin, Kelly, Constance and more), from houses such as Bonhams, Christie's, Sotheby's, Artcurial and many Drouot and Nordic houses. Returns house, sale title, dates, location, number of Hermès lots, the house's catalogue URL and a BirkinBagStock page. Call this when the user asks where or when Hermès bags are being auctioned.

house.description: Filter by auction house name, e.g. bonhams

status.description: upcoming (default, includes live), live, closed, all

name: list_hermes_auctions
